% Generated by `markov-lean paper` (preview: every number still waits on a run).
% Do not edit by hand; rerun the command. Missing numbers print as a red dash (\tbd).
\newcommand{\resNumProofs}{\tbd}  % LeanDojo proofs the Markov model was fit on (after the length filter)
\newcommand{\resNumSteps}{\tbd}  % tactic steps in those proofs
\newcommand{\resNumMicrostates}{\tbd}  % k-means microstates of the model
\newcommand{\resLag}{\tbd}  % lag tau of the model, in proof steps
\newcommand{\resNumMacrostates}{\tbd}  % PCCA+ macrostates m
\newcommand{\resSlowestTimescale}{\tbd}  % slowest implied timescale t2, in proof steps
\newcommand{\resChecksFailed}{\tbd}  % number of model checks that failed
\newcommand{\resNumLabelledSteps}{\tbd}  % judge-labelled steps the macrostates were scored on
\newcommand{\resMacroNMI}{\tbd}  % NMI of the macrostates against the judges' consensus MSC codes
\newcommand{\resMacroARI}{\tbd}  % ARI of the macrostates against the same labels
\newcommand{\resFolderNMI}{\tbd}  % NMI of the Mathlib-folder baseline
\newcommand{\resFolderARI}{\tbd}  % ARI of the Mathlib-folder baseline
\newcommand{\resRandomNMI}{\tbd}  % NMI of a random partition with the macrostates' sizes (robustness)
\newcommand{\resRandomARI}{\tbd}  % ARI of that random partition (robustness)
\newcommand{\resMacroAMI}{\tbd}  % AMI of the macrostates against the judges' consensus MSC codes (robustness)
\newcommand{\resMacroNMILo}{\tbd}  % lower end of the 95% bootstrap interval of the macrostates' NMI
\newcommand{\resMacroNMIHi}{\tbd}  % upper end of that interval
\newcommand{\resFolderAMI}{\tbd}  % AMI of the Mathlib-folder baseline (robustness)
\newcommand{\resNamespaceNMI}{\tbd}  % NMI of the theorem-namespace baseline (robustness)
\newcommand{\resNamespaceAMI}{\tbd}  % AMI of the theorem-namespace baseline (robustness)
\newcommand{\resKmeansNMI}{\tbd}  % NMI of k-means on the same goal-state features, no dynamics (robustness)
\newcommand{\resKmeansAMI}{\tbd}  % AMI of that k-means baseline (robustness)
\newcommand{\resNullRowNMI}{\tbd}  % mean NMI of the macrostates with their labels shuffled over all steps
\newcommand{\resNullRowP}{\tbd}  % p-value of the macrostates' NMI against that shuffle
\newcommand{\resNullProofNMI}{\tbd}  % mean NMI of the macrostates with whole proofs' sequences swapped (same length)
\newcommand{\resNullProofP}{\tbd}  % p-value of the macrostates' NMI against that swap
\newcommand{\resNullWithinNMI}{\tbd}  % mean NMI of the macrostates with their labels shuffled within each proof (significance)
\newcommand{\resNullWithinP}{\tbd}  % p-value of the macrostates' NMI against that within-proof shuffle
\newcommand{\resGateOne}{\tbd}  % gate 1 outcome: passed or failed
\newcommand{\resJudgeKappa}{\tbd}  % Cohen's kappa between the two judges on steps
\newcommand{\resJudgeAgreement}{\tbd}  % raw step-level agreement between the judges, in percent
\newcommand{\resJudgeCeilingNMI}{\tbd}  % NMI between the two judges (robustness ceiling)
\newcommand{\resSyntheticNMI}{\tbd}  % NMI of the macrostates against the planted areas on synthetic data
\newcommand{\resFlowsShown}{\tbd}  % number of flows drawn in the area-flow figure
\newcommand{\resFlowCoverage}{\tbd}  % share of area changes those flows cover, in percent
\newcommand{\resSearchSeeds}{\tbd}  % seeds per problem in the search runs
\newcommand{\resSearchCondition}{\tbd}  % search condition reported as the area prior (full, or area_l<lambda> on its own)
\newcommand{\resSearchExpansions}{\tbd}  % search budget: prover calls (expansions) per problem
\newcommand{\resSearchWallTime}{\tbd}  % search budget: wall time per problem, in seconds
\newcommand{\resSearchBaseMiniF}{\tbd}  % minif2f: problems solved (%) with the LM prior alone
\newcommand{\resSearchAreaMiniF}{\tbd}  % minif2f: problems solved (%) with the area prior
\newcommand{\resSearchGainMiniF}{\tbd}  % minif2f: change in problems solved, area prior minus LM prior, in points

\newcommand{\resSearchProblemsMiniF}{\tbd}  % minif2f: problems in the search runs
\newcommand{\resSearchStatementErrorsMiniF}{\tbd}  % minif2f: problems whose statement fails to elaborate (unsolved in every condition)
\newcommand{\resSearchBasePutnam}{\tbd}  % putnam: problems solved (%) with the LM prior alone
